correctness.rationale: The one-collision a map alone decreases rank, each effective a deletes one image state, and the omitted n prevents the next a from being effective. One b after that omission instead leaves 1 missing, forcing at least two intervening letters. Equality requires exactly b² between a's and the initial effective a first: w_s=a(b²a)^(s−1). The hole action under b²a is F(n)=3, F(n−3)=1, F(j)=j+3 in the pre-saturation range; tracing residues mod 3 yields h_n=2n/3 if 3|n, else floor(n/3)+1. The forced word then stops gaining a deficiency. This symbolic argument covers n≥4; independent bitmask subset-BFS (n=4..13) confirmed minima, uniqueness, and strict next threshold; the package's distinct BFS routine and witness/hole checks (n=4..18/300) were inspected, not relied on as logs alone.
residual_risks: Proof only initial 1≤s≤h_n and strict lower-bound failure at next deficiency; no full-rank-spectrum formula and no inference from finite experiments to n>13.
Finite BFS checks only n=4..13 for automata; all-n correctness rests on the symbolic proof, not those samples.
